title: Self-Pay Visit Package Fee Schedule: Tiers, Prices and Validity
content:
**Self-Pay Visit Package — fee schedule.** Each tier of the Self-Pay Visit Package is sold with a fixed number of visits, a list price, a validity period and the standard single-visit cash rate that goes with it.

| Tier | Visits included | List price (before any discount) | Single-visit cash rate | Validity after activation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | 4 | $460.00 | $125.00 | 90 calendar days |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | 6 | $666.00 | $125.00 | 120 calendar days |
| Core 8-Visit Package | 8 | $856.00 | $125.00 | 150 calendar days |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | 12 | $1236.00 | $125.00 | 180 calendar days |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | 18 | $1764.00 | $125.00 | 240 calendar days |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | 24 | $2256.00 | $125.00 | 365 calendar days |

**Column definitions**

- *Visits included* — the number of package visits the tier contains, a whole number.
- *List price* — the price of the tier before any discount, in US dollars to the cent.
- *Single-visit cash rate* — the standard cash rate for one visit, in US dollars to the cent. It is the rate used to value visits already used when a package is refunded and the rate at which visits beyond the package are priced.
- *Validity* — the number of calendar days after activation until the package expires.

**Reading the schedule**

The list price divided by the visits included gives the per-visit price of each tier at list price: $115.00 for the Starter 4-Visit Package, $111.00 for the Recovery 6-Visit Package, $107.00 for the Core 8-Visit Package, $103.00 for the Complete 12-Visit Package, $98.00 for the Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package and $94.00 for the Comprehensive 24-Visit Package. Every tier carries the same single-visit cash rate of $125.00.

*Hypothetical reading:* a Recovery 6-Visit Package activated on a given day remains valid for 120 calendar days counted from that activation; a Comprehensive 24-Visit Package activated the same day remains valid for 365 calendar days.
